svg.title: Eastern DRC: Areas of Control
svg.desc: Situation map covering 27.1°E to 30.3°E, 4.7°S to 0.9°N. Schematic · North and South Kivu, along the Albertine Rift. Areas of control in 3 classes: Government (FARDC), M23 / AFC, Contested (approx.) (contested). Marked: Contested city (approx.). Schematic polygons drawn by hand from the sources below, not a geocoded dataset. Open-source reporting (Critical Threats Congo Security Review, IPIS, Al Jazeera). As of ~25 September 2026 · illustrative, not an operational assessment. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
